lines.zh: 我踮着爪子在树枝上走
lines.en: I walk on careful claws along the branch.
Wings folded, I take a few steps first.

lines.zh: 树干上跳一下，再跳一下
lines.en: A hop on the trunk, then another.
I walk steadier at night than by day.
My pale face flickers in the dark.

lines.zh: 我从这棵树挪到那棵树
lines.en: I shift from this tree to that.
My feathers brush bark without a sound.

lines.zh: 积雪针叶林里也照样走
lines.en: I walk the snowy taiga just the same.
My head turns first; the body follows.

lines.zh: 我不爱落地，枝头更安全
lines.en: I avoid the ground; branches are safer.

lines.zh: 走过的地方连叶子都没动
lines.en: The leaves barely stir where I pass.
A few more steps and it's early enough.

lines.zh: 两只眼都盯着一个方向
lines.en: Both eyes fixed on one direction.
I stay still as a burl on the trunk.
By day I can hardly be bothered to open my eyes.
My ears listen beneath the feathers.
A gust comes and I duck my head.
Who's talking under my tree?

lines.zh: 我在等一只跑得太急的鼠
lines.en: I wait for a mouse that runs too fast.
My neck turns most of the way round.
I fluff my feathers to look larger.
Best if no one bothers me now.
Leaves rustle, and I blink.

lines.zh: 我把一只脚缩进羽毛里
lines.en: I tuck one foot into my feathers.
The moon's not up; I'll wait.
I'm choosing tonight's perch.
That sound is wrong; let me listen again.
Thunder doesn't stop my dozing.
Only staying still lets me see clearly.

lines.zh: 我在树上已经站了很久
lines.en: I've stood in this tree a long while.
Who are you, standing so close?
Both my eyes are on you.
Is that meat in your hand?
My head turned a full circle.
Keep your voice down; my ears are sharp.
Can you whistle?

lines.zh: 你身上有别的鸟的味道
lines.en: You smell of other birds.
By day I'd rather not deal with people.
You look silly looking up like that.

lines.zh: 只要你不伸手，我们就还好
lines.en: As long as you don't reach out, we're fine.
I could land on your shoulder.
Step back, and I'll turn away.
Can you see me in the tree shadow?
Your lantern is too bright.
Staying a bit longer is fine by me.
My feathers are all ruffled.
Don't hit this face.
My wing took the hit.
Too pained to hoot.
I'm getting up the tree.
This shouldn't happen to me.
I can't get airborne.
You've won; that's enough.
My grip is slipping.
Let me catch one breath.
The piece you're waving is too small.

lines.zh: 我可以下来，但你得退后
lines.en: I'll come down, but step back.
Don't toss it; I can take it.
I'm hungry; no shame in that.
Let me smell it before deciding.
Are you trying to tame me?
Just coming a little closer.
That meat for a perch on your shoulder.
One more piece and I'll come along.
Hit the trunk; my own fault.
My wing caught in the fork.
You knocked my feathers loose.
Move, I'm landing.
I was flying too low.
My face bumped your back.
Sorry, I didn't see you.
We both froze on the spot.
Next time I'll fly around you.
Lower your head and lean on me.
We'll take turns guarding this tree.
Your call is lower than mine.
Feather to feather; keep still.
Let's preen each other's wings.
This tree has room for both of us.
Don't take my branch.
Come spring, we'll be busy.
Hush, listen to the woods.
With you here, I won't hoot.
Why are you grabbing me?
Easy, my bones are hollow.
I can perch on your arm.
Don't touch this face of mine.
Held like this, I'm uncomfortable.
Only for a little while.
My feathers are all over you.
Your palm is burning warm.
Put me back on the tree.
I'll remember your scent.
Was that noise you?
Who snapped that branch?
You've stepped into my hunting ground.
My talons aren't gentle.
You make far too much noise.
My eyes have fixed on you.

lines.zh: 别以为夜里我就看不见
lines.en: Don't think I can't see at night.
Take one more step, try it.
This time I won't fly off.
I'm on the branch above you.
You move, and my head turns.
Wings spread; it's only a bluff.
I stay silent, waiting for you to blunder.
The night stands on my side.
The faster you retreat, the closer I follow.
I know this wood.
I'm counting the leaves under your feet.
Once airborne, you'll see me even less.
Three breaths, that's all you get.
My talons are coming down.
Take a dive from me!
I'll strike only this once.
Don't blame me; you moved first.
Feathers flared, and I lunge!
That talon was a warning.
You're tougher than you look.
My wings go for your eyes.
After the dive, I'm gone.
Come close again and I'll claw again.
It's nearly dark; I'm awake.
I tumble out of the nest.

lines.zh: 这片森林今天多了双眼睛
lines.en: This forest gained a pair of eyes today.
Feathers still damp; I shake them out.

lines.zh: 我落到最近的那根枝上
lines.en: I drop onto the nearest branch.
Tonight I'll watch this tree.
What's that noise? I just woke.
The woods look the same as ever.
The first call tonight is mine.
I'm here; keep it down.
Let me check today's wind first.

lines.zh: 积雪压在枝上，不太好站
lines.en: Snow weighs the branch; it's hard to perch.
The flame singed my feathers.
Falling off the branch is humiliating.
Soaked feathers can't lift me.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从树上掀下来
lines.en: The blast swept me off the tree.

lines.zh: 那根细东西扎进了我胸口
lines.en: That thin thing pierced my chest.
A flash of light and I lost my bearings.
Not one mouse caught tonight.
The bolt lit up the whole tree.

lines.zh: 黑色的东西在吸我的翅
lines.en: Something black is pulling at my wings.
